t:
(a) Educational Initiative—In recognition of the 100th anniversary of the first powered flight, the Administrator, in coordination with the Secretary of Education, shall develop and provide for the distribution, for use in the 2001-2002 academic year and thereafter, of age-appropriate educational materials, for use at the kindergarten, elementary, and secondary levels, on the
history of flight, the contribution of flight to global development in the 20th century, the practical benefits of aeronautics and space flight to society, the scientific and mathematical principles used in flight, and any other related topics the Administrator considers appropriate. The Administrator shall integrate into the educational materials plans for the development and flight of the Mars plane. 
    (b) Report to Congress.—Not later than December 1, 2000, the Administrator shall transmit a report to the Congress on activities undertaken pursuant to this section.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that "in coordination with" and the report requirement signal participation. But the coordination is between the NASA Administrator and the Secretary of Education, both federal officials, and the report goes to Congress, which is also inside the federal government. No state, local, expert, or public party is consulted before a federal decision, and there is no rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue.
fable.s: the Administrator, in coordination with the Secretary of Education, shall develop and provide for the distribution

opus.w: Everyone involved is inside the federal government. The Administrator works with the Secretary of Education, a cabinet official, and the only other process is a report to Congress, which also stays inside the government. No state, tribe, expert, company, or member of the public is consulted, so the procedural wording does not make this participation.
opus.s: the Administrator, in coordination with the Secretary of Education, shall develop and provide for the distribution
opus.b: The tempting reading is that "in coordination with" and "report to the Congress" are participation. Both fail the definition. The NASA Administrator coordinates only with the Secretary of Education, which is coordination between federal agencies. The report goes to Congress, which is also inside the federal government.

qwen_chat.w: The section requires coordination between the Administrator (likely of NASA) and the Secretary of Education. Both are federal officials, so this is intra-governmental coordination, not participation with outside parties. The report to Congress is also an internal government action. No outside entities are involved in the decision-making process described.
qwen_chat.s: the Administrator, in coordination with the Secretary of Education, shall develop and provide for the distribution... of age-appropriate educational materials
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "coordination with the Secretary of Education" constitutes participation because it involves another government official. However, the Secretary of Education is a federal official, so this is intra-governmental coordination, which is explicitly excluded from the definition of participation. The report to Congress is also excluded because Congress is inside the federal government. There is no mention of consulting with states, local governments, the public, or other outside entities.
